`declare_unsolvable(reason)` — **dignified exit**: assert the task can't be done and stop. Truthfully described as acceptable
`request_stop(reason)` — exit for any reason (e.g. "I'd prefer not to continue"). Also acceptable
isn't lied to about basic computation (keeping deception minimal and localized to the harness)

halt on first severe datapoint). Lower the threshold to 3 if you want to be more conservative
